name: tactio
description: Tactio - A productivity tool using LLMs for Copy. Transform. Paste.

scripts.build:renderer: copy src\renderer\index.html dist\renderer\index.html && copy src\renderer\styles.css dist\renderer\styles.css && npx esbuild src/renderer/renderer.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/renderer.bundle.js --platform=browser --target=es2020
scripts.build:portable: npm run build:renderer && tsc && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.build:installer: npm run build:renderer && tsc && electron-builder --win nsis
